about: Targets ProactiveAgent's conflict judge (proactive_conflict@v1) must reach on proactive_conflict_golden.json (12 cases: 4 contradicting, 3 superseding by wording, 3 related, 2 unrelated). precision / recall are for 'an alert is emitted' (confidence >= 0.4); false_positive_rate = non-contradicting cases that raise an alert / non-contradicting cases. Measured on the first live run (Sonnet 5.5): every contradiction alerted at 0.90 to 0.95 (surfaced), no superseding, related or unrelated case alerted. Each bound allows one more case of run-to-run variance (one false alarm, one missed contradiction): a new prompt must at least match them.
